1.note: The decision-lifting duty is read in the governing-sources detail: lift decisions that keep governing code; task-only choices remain in the task.

10.note: Manager is one master-scoped owner of the builder/reviewer/curator closeout chain.

11.note: Worker is one leaf-scoped builder whose terminal artifact is the turn report.

12.note: The capsule vocabulary holds eight roles — architect, orchestrator, manager, worker, curator, reviewer, investigator and bootstrap — the same set the launcher can select; the launcher also accepts the system-specialist alias.

13.note: Worker and reviewer roles define the two independent halves of per-ID acceptance.

14.note: The graph-less atomic-sequential default describes sprint shape; nothing serializes the masters.

16.note: Lifecycle publication and recovery carry the actual code/memory outputs.

17.note: The ordinary converted-memory onboarding row is updated with a counted card change or no_impact, and the writer binds it to every covered source file's blob.

18.note: The Curator's file-writer step uses mounted knowledge_write or the admitted serving-build command-line writer.

19.note: Taskless subject and one coordinating agent under the Architect.

2.note: The Reviewer's step 7 compares declared expectedKnowledgeEffects with the leaf's requirement packet; a mismatch is a finding.

20.note: Master coordination under the Architect and exact paired scope.

21.note: Sprint coordination above one Manager per master and separate evidence.

23.note: Independent exact assigned review and sealed findings.

24.note: Bound and preserved normal Curator duties.

25.note: Taskless real concern and report-first remediation.

26.note: The Curator keeps the admitted writer for normal records, sidecar entries and history, and never edits the derived index. A covered correct-input write refusal uses only its declared same-tool/input-class recovery, with owner notice, manual provenance and working checks.

27.note: The canonical role owns this concern and mutation boundary.

28.note: Stage boundaries, the settings-owned review budget and recorded approval duties are carried by the role instruction sources, for example the Manager's stop list.

29.note: Role registry and native supported-role vocabulary are distinct; the prior Investigator spelling is canonicalized on input.

3.note: Families are authored as records with their own guarantee, members, routes and admission, name members only by identifier, and are read back through knowledge_read with view family.

30.note: Role selection checks operation applicability and selects no shared core for a dispatched role. For every card cut by the quality check, the Curator names the source evidence that makes the removed text untrue; text is never removed merely to clear a quality finding.

31.note: Independent MEMORY review reads both landing reports and raises missing cut-change reasons or extra-knowledge additions without a requirement place.

32.note: Architect delegates one master to Manager and concurrent masters to Orchestrator; direct coordination requires the developer.

33.note: Normal leaf starts are individual role_start calls: Worker at build, Reviewer at freeze, Curator after code PASS. Start notices reach Manager first; exact-object peer handovers remain direct, Manager retains gate and transaction ownership, and held delivery is not resent.

34.note: Worker leaves code uncommitted; sync conflict content, staging and continuation have separate owners.

35.note: Reviewer independently checks exact attempts, knowledge-effect declarations and separately sealed memory evidence.

36.note: Settings-bound fix verification preserves existing findings; beyond-limit work requires recorded architect/developer approval through Manager.

37.note: Converted leaf ingest requires a contract/list/authorization, writes only with the file-write flag, and routes converted memory to the file writer. Anchor: `add_arguments`, `run`

38.note: Families are authored as records items and external documents as card references; the file writer does not read the entry keys family and external_sources.

39.note: Curator authors scope, completes full MQC and coherence, and records no separate Reviewer-owned Git comparison.

4.note: The per-target authored rationale lives in the knowledge-ingest preparation detail and the report-state reading in the ingest-report detail.

40.note: Raw quality is retained separately; combined readiness changes only when coherence validation fails after quality is ready.

41.note: Current native Curator launch resolves and validates the canonical sprint/master/leaf chain; the removed generic task-binding module supplies no current taskless Curator admission, and the foundation task the Architect opens is an ordinary leaf on that chain.

42.note: The retained repository-context admission helper refuses enclosure_in_scope; the current authoring route is separately admitted inside the actual Architect task/enclosure.

43.note: Native enclosure preparation reads contract-scoped status and refuses unsuccessful preparation; this alone does not prove the historical whole-path lineage claim.

44.note: Graph absence declares no dependencies and resolves the atomic shape without serializing masters. Anchor: `resolve_scheduling_mode`, `effective_execution_nature`

45.note: Developer answers require receiving identity and quoted words; unanswered/denied permissions have no bypass, and held messages are not resent.

46.note: Current closeout doctrine consumes exact authority and evidence without substituting raw Git or blanket full-suite gates.

48.note: Canonical skills feed the declaration-owned single package target through the shared generator; this source inventory is not a synchronization verdict.

49.note: Native start, finalize and abandon publish task stage and its parent mirror; Manager avoids a redundant status write while retaining explicit corrections and organizational-master completion.

5.note: The serving-build and ingest-report details supply the writer invocation and written/planned/refused report reading; the Curator report names writer state, written record and entry identifiers and paths, history rows and refusal reasons.

50.note: The composition manifest declares each operation's section audience ("sections", or "all" for authorized closeout) and the roles it applies to; these are source declarations, not execution acceptance.

51.note: The shared writing profile governs invariant statements, family guarantees, history reasons and walkthrough prose, and preserves conditions, exceptions, quantifiers and negation.

52.note: Worker, Curator and Reviewer each mark only the task step naming their own part done; with no such step they report and set nothing, and the Reviewer marks its step only after the last round is recorded passed.

53.note: Memory review keeps separate sealed reports, finding identifiers and pass count, recorded with reviewKind=memory, and changes no code review state.

6.note: Normal knowledge authoring uses mounted knowledge_write or the admitted serving-build knowledge-ingest route. Only a covered correct-input refusal admits recovery for that same tool and input class; no other write gains the exception.

63.note: Worker repairs owned findings directly and retains the per-finding freeze trail.

64.note: Manager settles covered precedents and adds no pre-repair go-ahead.

65.note: The Architect verifies copied developer words against the filed message and claims a master when its record does not name this Architect.

66.note: The first message also delivers the shared every-role digest beside the rendered capsule. The manifest declares it separately, and compilation returns its text apart from render_instructions(); the admitted digest revision contributes to semantic identity. This separate delivery does not prepend the larger retained core doctrine to the role/operation instruction stream.

67.note: Current curation continues from a report to the next authorized step without a new Manager go. It verifies card sentences against source, repairs wrong or missing memory encountered along its way beyond quality-check findings, names each repair and makes no broad sweep. Code changes, requirement decisions and another leaf’s work return to their owner. A correction qualifies every affected false body claim; full checks and the independent fact-check run before handover.

7.note: The Curator report names writer-report state, written record and entry identifiers and paths, history rows and each refusal's own reason.

8.note: Curation keeps scope and producer-ownership boundaries; the serving-build and ingest-report details hold the invocation and report-reading method.

9.note: The curator owns affected onboarding and admitted knowledge authoring, with full diagnostics and a structured handoff; code, gate, lifecycle and closeout writes stay outside the seat, and task-document edits stay within its own assignment.
